finding.problem: Removing the backwards-time guard from _observe lets a decreasing `now` reach _in_window, whose left-only eviction assumes sorted deques, so stale entries stay counted (false denials, wrong remaining/retry_after) and a stale or huge `now` can bypass or lock out a key.
